audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Distance, refuge, king imagery, vows, protection, and faintness.

verses.restored: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

familiar.text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.restored: From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart grows faint; lead me to a rock higher than I.

familiar.text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

notes.title: End of the earth
notes.body: This is poetic distance and disorientation, not a cosmological map. The prayer moves from faintness toward refuge.

verses.restored: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

familiar.text: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.restored: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

familiar.text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.restored: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

familiar.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.restored: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

familiar.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

verses.restored: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

familiar.text: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.restored: So will I sing praise to thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

familiar.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Royal and enemy language is devotional poetry, not leader immunity or permission to harm opponents.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
